title: aster lyallii
intro: Aster lyallii, commonly known as the New Zealand tree daisy, is a flowering plant species native to New Zealand. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and prevent infection. The therapeutic actions of Aster lyallii include its ability to reduce inflammation, calm the nervous system, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Aster lyallii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and polyphenols, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
